rubrics.justification: The response failed to use the provided Gardner score 3AB and incorrectly stated morphology could not be assessed, despite sufficient grading data being available.

It integrates most relevant factors well, including age, ovarian reserve, BMI, sperm quality, endometrium, and endometriosis, though it does so based on an assumed embryo grade rather than the provided 3AB.
The reasoning is generally structured and logical, but it is weakened by the central error of ignoring the known embryo grade and building conclusions around hypothetical morphology categories.

Much of the counseling is broadly evidence-based, but recommendations such as routine GnRH suppression, PGT-A consideration in a young first-cycle patient, and ERA/immunologic workup are presented too readily relative to guideline-supported indications.
The response offers practical next steps, but several are generic or not well tailored to this actual case because it overlooks the provided 3AB grading and overemphasizes optional adjuncts.
